result.summary: Found 1 visible visual defect: a loading indicator is stuck over a restaurant image.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a large loading spinner centered over its food image, obscuring the thumbnail while the rest of the page content is already rendered.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image finishes loading or replace the spinner with a stable image placeholder/skeleton that is removed promptly once loading completes.
